subject.title: fix(zalo): journal polled updates before dispatch

question: Should Zalo polling adopt the shared ingress drain's up-to-eight cross-chat delivery concurrency, replacing the historical one-polled-update-at-a-time dispatch behavior?
rationale: The patch fixes a concrete loss window, but durable admission also changes observable delivery scheduling and failure timing across independent chats; repository policy treats channel delivery behavior as owner-sensitive.

options.title: Adopt shared ingress concurrency
options.body: Accept the shared queue's cross-chat concurrency while retaining per-chat lanes, then rebase and verify the focused Zalo ingress paths.

options.title: Preserve serialized polling
options.body: Revise the polling integration so durable journaling remains in place but polling waits for each admitted delivery before fetching the next update.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared ingress concurrency
recommendation.body: Accept the shared queue's cross-chat concurrency while retaining per-chat lanes, then rebase and verify the focused Zalo ingress paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged webhook durability implementation establishes the Zalo ingress contract and its delivery-drain configuration.
